name: InteractiveGridPattern
description: A grid whose cells light up under the mouse or pen. Decoration only: it does nothing on touch or for reduced motion and never takes focus.

variant.description: fill lights the cell under the pointer; trail leaves a short fading trail of cells.

fade.description: Fades the grid out toward its edges.

requirements: Pure decoration: aria-hidden, never focusable, and pointer-events none so content on top stays usable
It is drawn with CSS only, so it needs no JavaScript and is safe in server HTML
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), with isStill, and inside an rdm-still container
Drift is slow and never flashes (WCAG 2.2.2, 2.3.1)
Hidden in forced-colors (high contrast) mode so it never fights system colours
Keep text on top at 4.5:1 against the lines: use a low-contrast token for the pattern
The pointer is read from the parent element only for mouse and pen; touch does nothing
It never takes the pointer or focus and never replaces a focus ring

use_when: A hero or empty state where a little pointer feedback adds life
avoid_when: Anything people must click: the effect is never a control
Touch-first screens, where it does nothing
anti_patterns: Using it as the only hover feedback
